SELECT tp.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, tp.TITLE AS title, tp.ADDR1 AS addr1, tp.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.ID) AS imageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT rv.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewImageCount FROM TOUR_PLACE tp LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG pi ON tp.CONTENT_ID = pi.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW rv ON tp.CONTENT_ID = rv.CONTENT_ID AND rv.REVIEW_IMAGE IS NOT NULL AND rv.REVIEW_IMAGE != '' AND rv.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y'
(tp.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tp.ADDR1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (tp.FIRST_IMAGE IS NULL OR tp.FIRST_IMAGE = '')
GROUP BY tp.CONTENT_ID, tp.TITLE, tp.ADDR1, tp.FIRST_IMAGE ORDER BY reviewImageCount DESC, imageCount ASC

SELECT rv.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, rv.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, rv.CONTENT AS content FROM REVIEW rv JOIN USERS u ON rv.USER_ID = u.NO WHERE rv.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND rv.REVIEW_IMAGE IS NOT NULL AND rv.REVIEW_IMAGE != '' AND rv.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY rv.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT ID AS imageId, IMG_NAME AS imgName, ORIGIN_IMG_URL AS originImgUrl FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} ORDER BY ID DESC
